name: perf-v3
comment: Hardware counters on measured/v3 (ADR 0084): the protocol of the main campaign, 30 runs per configuration, while scripts/perf-counters.sh counts the P-cores system-wide in 100 ms intervals. The atomic histogram as in perf-v2 (ADR 0072), plus the filter and the local histogram at k = 256, for instructions, cycles and cache misses per pixel. The run times are not reported; the counters are.
